title: Deploy Analysis Views with AL Code in Business Central 2026 Wave 1 (No Manual Setup)

chapters.title: Overview of analysis views feature in BC 2026 Wave 1
Microsoft documentation and technical implementation details
Exporting and examining analysis JSON files
Item ledger entries demonstration with locked and unlocked views

Generating analysis JSON files from Copilot suggestions
Creating and deploying analysis views through AL extension
Publishing and testing monthly trends analysis with Copilot
Manual configuration and JSON file naming

features.name: Analysis views packaged in AL extensions
features.description: Analysis views can now be exported as JSON files and included in AL extensions, allowing them to be deployed as part of the codebase and version controlled across multiple environments and tenants.
caveats: Requires using analysis mode in web client to export
JSON file must be included in extension package

features.name: Analysis JSON export from web client
features.description: Users can export analysis views as analysis.json files directly from the analysis mode in the Business Central web client, which can then be included in AL extensions.
caveats: Analysis must be created in analysis mode first
File naming must match extension configuration

features.name: Locked analysis views
features.description: Analysis views deployed via AL extensions appear as locked tabs in analysis mode, preventing end-users from modifying the design while allowing them to duplicate and customize copies.
caveats: Locked views cannot be changed by end-users
Users can duplicate locked views to create customizable copies

features.name: Copilot for Excel analysis design
features.description: Copilot integrated in Excel can analyze exported Business Central data and suggest analysis view designs, generating JSON proposals for monthly trends, revenue analysis, and other summaries.
caveats: Requires Python packages to be installed
Generated JSON needs manual review before deployment
Claude for Excel mentioned as alternative

features.name: Data export to Excel for analysis
features.description: Item ledger entries and other Business Central data can be exported to Excel for further analysis using Copilot or Claude to design analysis views.

features.name: Analysis view component in page AL syntax
features.description: AL pages now support an analysis views section where developers can define analysis view components with name, file path, and caption to reference JSON-based analysis definitions.
caveats: Requires proper JSON file naming and path configuration

features.name: Multi-environment analysis view deployment
features.description: Analysis views can be easily deployed across multiple Business Central environments and tenants through AL extensions, enabling standardized data analysis across the organization.

features.name: Analysis views via AL code
features.description: Deploy analysis views with rows, columns and optional filters by defining them in JSON files and including them in AL extensions, eliminating the need for manual UI setup.
caveats: Analysis view JSON files must end with 'analysis.json' filename suffix
Cannot publish if extension is used in multiple apps without uninstalling first

features.name: Copilot for analysis view suggestions
features.description: Copilot can analyze table structures and suggest high-value analysis views for specific business domains like inventory and cost analysis, including recommended dimensions and filters.
caveats: JSON output from Copilot may not always be downloadable directly
Suggested analyses may need manual review and adjustment

features.name: Ad hoc analysis mode
features.description: Users can switch to ad hoc analysis view in the UI to see pivot-style analysis of item ledger entries with rows, columns and aggregations by dimensions like posting date and customer group.

features.name: Analysis view dimensions and pivoting
features.description: Analysis views support grouping data by row dimensions, column dimensions (pivots), and applying filters. Dimensions can come from related tables and the same field can be used as rows or pivots.
caveats: When duplicating analysis views, pivot configuration may be lost and requires reconfiguration
UI can be slow loading related tables when adding fields

features.name: Analysis view export and import cycle
features.description: Users can export analysis view definitions from the UI, import them into AL projects as JSON files, include them in pages, and optionally re-export and re-import definitions.
caveats: JSON file must be named with 'analysis.json' suffix to be recognized
Related table loading can be slow in the UI

features.name: Cross-table analysis views
features.description: Analysis views can add columns from related tables beyond the main table, enabling analysis that combines data from multiple table sources.
caveats: UI performance can be slow when loading related table options

features.name: Analysis view JSON file format
features.description: Analysis view definition files must end with analysis.json to be distinguished from other JSON file types.
caveats: Naming convention is required

features.name: Copilot-generated analysis mode tabs
features.description: Copilot can create analysis mode tabs automatically for analysis views.

features.name: Analysis mode with queries
features.description: Analysis mode can be used with queries, including Microsoft-provided queries for fixed assets module.

features.name: Microsoft query for projects
features.description: Microsoft provides a query for the projects module that can be used with analysis mode to analyze project data and lifecycle.

features.name: Add related table fields to pages
features.description: Pages can be extended to include fields from related tables using UI without requiring code.
